name: managing-transfer-pricing-compliance
description: Drafts and reviews transfer pricing compliance for intercompany pricing under IRC 482, Treas. Reg. 1.482-1 to 1.482-9 and the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines: functional analysis (FAR, DEMPE), best method and tested party selection, profit level indicators, benchmarking and comparable accept/reject review, interquartile range and median by the regulation's percentile rule, year-end true-ups with customs and VAT effects, intercompany agreements against conduct, services cost method, intangible transfers and cost sharing, intercompany loans and the AFR safe haven, IRC 6662(e) penalty exposure, 1.6662-6(d) contemporaneous documentation, and Form 8975 country-by-country reporting. Use for TP study, local file, benchmarking, arm's length range, IDR documentation, TP penalties, or the pricing analysis behind an APA proposal or MAP position. Cross-border structure, 367(d) and Pillar Two route to analyzing-international-tax-planning; domestic structure to analyzing-corporate-tax-structures. Drafts for review.
